test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If ‘White’ is called ‘Blue’, ‘Blue’ is called ‘Red’, ‘Red’ is called ‘Yellow’, Yellow' is called ‘Green’, ‘Green’ is called ‘Black’, ‘Black’ is called ‘Violet’, and ‘Violet’ is called ‘Orange’, then what would be the colour of human blood?
solution:
If 

 
• ‘White’ is called ‘Blue’
 
• ‘Blue’ is called ‘Red’
 
• ‘Red’ is called ‘Yellow’
 
• Yellow' is called ‘Green’
 
• ‘Green’ is called ‘Black’
 
• ‘Black’ is called ‘Violet’
 
• ‘Violet’ is called ‘Orange’

The colour of human blood is Red and ‘Red’ is called ‘Yellow'.

Therefore, 'Yellow' would be the colour of human blood.

Hence, '**Yellow**' is the correct answer.
